name: The Homeschool Compass Team
bio: The Homeschool Compass editorial team researches homeschool curricula and state requirements so families can compare them without wading through marketing. We read what publishers say about their own materials before we describe them, we take legal requirements from each state's published rules, and we report what a curriculum actually teaches — including who it is not for. We are not a curriculum publisher and we do not sell courses. Every fact on this site links back to its source so you can verify it yourself.
